name: studypulse
description: StudyPulse - Focus, Reminders, Flashcards & Study Planner

scripts.cap:sync: node prepare-build.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: node prepare-build.js && npx cap sync android && powershell -Command "Set-Location './android'; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug; Copy-Item './app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk' -Destination '../StudyPulse.apk' -Force"
